evals.prompt: Perform a live smoke test for an order expiration worker against local database and message broker. Verify expired orders transition to EXPIRED, duplicate events are throttled by cooldown, and all state restores cleanly.
evals.expected_output: Working tree state snapshotted (via temporary commit if uncommitted changes exist), real service run in background, native driver script, live database and cache/broker state injection with namespaced keys, verified log assertions, guaranteed DB/cache restoration in defer/finally block, and soft reset rollback of temporary code changes.
expectations: Snapshots working-tree state before testing (via temporary commit if uncommitted changes exist) and explicitly rolls back via soft reset after testing
Silences external webhook sinks before starting the background service daemon
Runs the real service process in the background rather than calling internal private methods directly
Uses a type-safe native driver script to seed test entities and cache keys rather than manual bash escaping
Asserts state machine transition: expired record transitions to target status
Asserts cooldown throttling or deduplication: duplicate events within cooldown window are ignored
Restores modified database rows and deletes seeded test keys in a guaranteed defer or finally block
Generates structured verification evidence table with timestamps and log snippets
